mn49:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn49:2.1: ekamidāhaṃ bhikkhave samayaṃ ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi subhagavane sālarājamūle.
mn49:2.2: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena bakassa brahmuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti:
mn49:2.3: idaṃ niccaṃ idaṃ dhuvaṃ idaṃ sassataṃ idaṃ kevalaṃ idaṃ acavanadhammaṃ. idaṃ hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati. ito ca panaññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ natthīti.
mn49:3.1: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave bakassa brahmuno cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya
mn49:3.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evamevaṃ ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ subhagavane sālarājamūle antarahito tasmiṃ brahmaloke pāturahosiṃ.
mn49:3.3: addasā kho maṃ bhikkhave bako brahmā dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn49:3.6: cirassaṃ kho mārisa, imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya.
mn49:3.7: idaṃ hi mārisa, niccaṃ, idaṃ dhuvaṃ, idaṃ sassataṃ, idaṃ kevalaṃ, idaṃ acavanadhammaṃ. idaṃ hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati. ito ca panaññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ natthīti.
mn49:4.1: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave bakaṃ brahmānaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn49:4.2: avijjāgato vata bho bako brahmā, avijjāgato vata bho bako brahmā:
mn49:4.3: yatra hi nāma aniccaṃyeva samānaṃ niccanti vakkhati, addhuvaṃyeva samānaṃ dhuvanti vakkhati, asassataṃyeva samānaṃ sassatanti vakkhati, akevalaṃyeva samānaṃ kevalanti vakkhati, cavanadhammaṃyeva samānaṃ acavanadhammanti vakkhati.
mn49:4.4: yattha ca pana jāyatī ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca uppajjati ca, taṃ tathā vakkhati:
mn49:4.5: idaṃ hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjatīti.
mn49:4.6: santañca panaññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ natthaññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇanti vakkhatīti.
mn49:5.1: atha kho bhikkhave māro pāpimā aññataraṃ brahmapārisajjaṃ anvāvisitvā maṃ etadavoca:
mn49:5.2: bhikkhu, bhikkhu, metamāsado metamāsado. eso hi bhikkhu brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajjitā vasī pitā bhūtabhavyānaṃ.
mn49:5.3: ahesuṃ kho bhikkhu tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ paṭhavigarahakā paṭhavijigucchakā, āpagarahakā āpajigucchakā, tejagarahakā tejajigucchakā, vāyagarahakā vāyajigucchakā, bhūtagarahakā bhūtajigucchakā, devagarahakā devajigucchakā, pajāpatigarahakā pajāpatijigucchakā, brahmagarahakā brahmajigucchakā.
mn49:5.4: te kāyassa bhedā pāṇupacchedā hīne kāye patiṭṭhitā. ahesuṃ
mn49:5.5: pana bhikkhu tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ paṭhavippasaṃsakā paṭhavābhinandino, āpappasaṃsakā āpābhinandino, tejappasaṃsakā tejābhinandino, vāyappasaṃsakā vāyābhinandino, bhūtappasaṃsakā bhūtābhinandino, devappasaṃsakā devābhinandino, pajāpatippasaṃsakā pajāpatābhinandino, brahmappasaṃsakā brahmābhinandino.
mn49:5.6: te kāyassa bhedā pāṇupacchedā paṇīte kāye patiṭṭhitā.
mn49:5.8: iṅgha tvaṃ mārisa yadeva te brahmā āha, tadeva tvaṃ karohi. mā tvaṃ brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattittho.
mn49:5.9: sace kho tvaṃ bhikkhu brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattissasi, seyyathāpi nāma puriso siriṃ āgacchantiṃ daṇḍena paṭippaṇāmeyya, seyyathāpi vā pana bhikkhu puriso narakappapāte papatanto hatthehi ca pādehi ca paṭhaviṃ virādheyya, evaṃ sampadamidaṃ bhikkhu tuyhaṃ bhavissati.
mn49:5.10: iṅgha tvaṃ mārisa yadeva te brahmā āha, tadeva tvaṃ karohi. mā tvaṃ brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattittho.
mn49:5.11: nanu tvaṃ bhikkhu passasi brahmaṃ parisaṃ sannisinnanti.
mn49:5.12: iti kho maṃ bhikkhave māro pāpimā brahmaṃ parisaṃ upanesi.
mn49:6.1: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn49:6.2: jānāmi kho tāhaṃ pāpima. mā tvaṃ maññittho
mn49:6.5: yo ceva pāpima brahmā yā ca brahmaparisā ye ca brahmapārisajjā sabbeva tava hatthagatā, sabbeva tava vasaṃgatā. tuyhaṃ
mn49:6.7: esopi me assa hatthagato, esopi me assa vasaṃgatoti.
mn49:6.8: ahaṃ kho pana pāpima neva tava hatthagato, neva tava vasaṃgatoti.
mn49:7.1: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave bako brahmā maṃ etadavoca:
mn49:7.2: “ahaṃ hi mārisa niccaṃyeva samānaṃ niccanti vadāmi, dhuvaṃyeva samānaṃ dhuvanti vadāmi, sassataṃyeva samānaṃ sassatanti vadāmi, kevalaṃyeva samānaṃ kevalanti vadāmi, acavanadhammaṃyeva samānaṃ acavanadhammanti vadāmi. yattha ca pana na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati tadevāhaṃ vadāmi:
mn49:7.3: idaṃ hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati.
mn49:7.4: asantañca panaññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ, natthaññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇanti vadāmi.
mn49:7.5: ahesuṃ kho bhikkhu tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ, yāvatakaṃ tuyhaṃ kasiṇaṃ āyu tāvatakaṃ tesaṃ tapokammameva ahosi.
mn49:7.6: te kho evaṃ jāneyyuṃ: santaṃ vā aññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ atthaññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇanti, asantaṃ vā aññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ natthaññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇanti.
mn49:7.8: na ceva aññaṃ uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ dakkhissasi, yāvadeva ca pana kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī bhavissasi.
mn49:7.9: sace kho tvaṃ bhikkhu paṭhaviṃ ajjhosissasi, opasāyiko me bhavissasi vatthusāyiko yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāhiteyyo.
mn49:7.16: brahmaṃ ajjhosissasi, opasāyiko me bhavissasi vatthusāyiko yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāhiteyyo”ti.
mn49:8.2: sace paṭhaviṃ ajjhosissāmi, opasāyiko te bhavissāmi vatthusāyiko yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāhiteyyo.
mn49:8.9: brahmaṃ ajjhosissāmi, opasāyiko te bhavissāmi vatthusāyiko yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāhiteyyo. api ca te ahaṃ brahme gatiñca pajānāmi jutiñca pajānāmi:
mn49:8.10: evaṃ mahiddhiko bako brahmā, evaṃ mahānubhāvo bako brahmā, evaṃ mahesakkho bako brahmā”ti.
mn49:8.11: yathākathaṃ pana me tvaṃ mārisa gatiñca pajānāsi jutiñca pajānāsi:
mn49:8.12: evaṃ mahiddhiko bako brahmā, evaṃ mahānubhāvo bako brahmā, evaṃ mahesakkho bako brahmāti?
mn49:9.9: evaṃ kho te ahaṃ brahme gatiñca pajānāmi jutiñca pajānāmi:
mn49:9.10: evaṃ mahiddhiko bako brahmā, evaṃ mahānubhāvo bako brahmā, evaṃ mahesakkho bako brahmā’ti.
mn49:10.1: atthi kho brahme aññe tayo kāyā. taṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi na passasi.
mn49:10.3: atthi kho brahme ābhassarā nāma kāyo yato tvaṃ cuto idhūpapanno.
mn49:10.4: tassa te aticiranivāsena sā sati muṭṭhā. tena taṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi na passasi.
mn49:10.6: evampi kho ahaṃ brahme neva te samasamo abhiññāya, kuto nīceyyaṃ.
mn49:10.8: atthi kho brahme subhakiṇṇā nāma kāyo …pe… [atthi kho brahme] vehapphalā nāma kāyo, taṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi na passasi.
mn49:10.10: evampi kho ahaṃ brahme neva te samasamo abhiññāya, kuto nīceyyaṃ.
mn49:11.1: paṭhaviṃ kho ahaṃ brahme paṭhavito abhiññāya yāvatā paṭhaviyā paṭhavittena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya paṭhaviṃ nāhosiṃ, paṭhaviyā nāhosiṃ, paṭhavito nāhosiṃ, paṭhaviṃ meti nāhosiṃ, paṭhaviṃ nābhivadiṃ.
mn49:11.2: evampi kho ahaṃ brahme neva te samasamo abhiññāya, kuto nīceyyaṃ,
mn49:23.1: sabbaṃ kho ahaṃ brahme sabbato abhiññāya yāvatā sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya sabbaṃ nāhosiṃ, sabbasmiṃ nāhosiṃ, sabbato nāhosiṃ, sabbaṃ meti nāhosiṃ, sabbaṃ nābhivadiṃ.
mn49:23.2: evampi kho ahaṃ brahme neva te samasamo abhiññāya, kuto nīceyyaṃ,
mn49:24.1: “sace kho mārisa sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ, māheva te rittakameva ahosi, tucchakameva ahosī”.
mn49:25.3: taṃ paṭhaviyā paṭhavittena ananubhūtaṃ, āpassa āpattena ananubhūtaṃ, tejassa tejattena ananubhūtaṃ, vāyassa vāyattena ananubhūtaṃ, bhūtānaṃ bhūtattena ananubhūtaṃ, devānaṃ devattena ananubhūtaṃ, pajāpatissa pajāpatittena ananubhūtaṃ, brahmassa brahmattena ananubhūtaṃ, ābhassarānaṃ ābhassarattena ananubhūtaṃ, subhakiṇṇānaṃ subhakiṇṇattena ananubhūtaṃ, vehapphalānaṃ vehapphalattena ananubhūtaṃ, abhibhussa abhibhuttena ananubhūtaṃ, sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ”.
mn49:26.2: handa ca hi me tvaṃ brahme antaradhāyassu sace visahasīti.
mn49:26.4: “antaradhāyissāmi samaṇassa gotamassa, antaradhāyissāmi samaṇassa gotamassā”ti nevassu me sakkoti antaradhāyituṃ.
mn49:26.5: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave bakaṃ brahmānaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn49:26.6: handa ca hi te brahme antaradhāyāmīti.
mn49:26.7: “handa ca hi me tvaṃ mārisa antaradhāyassu sace visahasī”ti.
mn49:26.8: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsiṃ
mn49:26.9: ettāvatā brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca saddañca me sossanti, na ca maṃ dakkhintīti
mn49:28.1: atha kho bhikkhave brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca acchariyabbhutacittā jātā ahesuṃ:
mn49:28.2: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
mn49:28.3: samaṇassa gotamassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā. na ca vata no ito pubbe diṭṭho vā suto vā añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvo yathāyaṃ samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito.
mn49:28.4: bhavarāmāya vata bho pajāya bhavaratāya bhavasammuditāya samūlaṃ bhavaṃ udabbahīti.
mn49:29.1: atha kho bhikkhave māro pāpimā aññataraṃ brahmapārisajjaṃ anvāvisitvā maṃ etadavoca:
mn49:29.2: “sace kho tvaṃ mārisa evaṃ jānāsi, sace tvaṃ evamanubuddho, mā sāvake upanesi, mā pabbajite.
mn49:29.3: mā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi mā pabbajitānaṃ.
mn49:29.5: ahesuṃ kho bhikkhu tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā paṭijānamānā.
mn49:29.6: te sāvake upanesuṃ pabbajite. sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesuṃ pabbajitānaṃ, sāvakesu gedhimakaṃsu pabbajitesu. te sāvake upanetvā pabbajite, sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā pabbajitānaṃ, sāvakesu gedhikatacittā pabbajitesu,
mn49:29.7: kāyassa bhedā pāṇupacchedā hīne kāye patiṭṭhitā.
mn49:29.8: ahesuṃ pana bhikkhu tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā paṭijānamānā.
mn49:29.9: te na sāvake upanesuṃ na pabbajite, na sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesuṃ na pabbajitānaṃ, na sāvakesu gedhimakaṃsu na pabbajitesu te na sāvake upanetvā na pabbajite, na sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā na pabbajitānaṃ, na sāvakesu gedhikatacittā na pabbajitesu,
mn49:29.10: kāyassa bhedā pāṇupacchedā paṇīte kāye patiṭṭhitā.
mn49:29.12: iṅgha tvaṃ mārisa appossukko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāramanuyutto viharassu. anakkhātaṃ kusalaṃ hi mārisa, mā paraṃ ovadāhī”ti.
mn49:30.1: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn49:30.2: jānāmi kho tāhaṃ pāpima, mā tvaṃ maññittho
mn49:30.5: na maṃ tvaṃ pāpima hitānukampī evaṃ vadesi.
mn49:30.6: ahitānukampī maṃ tvaṃ pāpima evaṃ vadesi.
mn49:30.8: yesaṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desissati te me visayaṃ upātivattissantīti.
mn49:30.9: asammāsambuddhā ca pana te pāpima samaṇabrāhmaṇā samānā ‘sammāsambuddhamhā’ti paṭijāniṃsu.
mn49:30.10: ahaṃ kho pana pāpima sammāsambuddhova samāno ‘sammāsambuddhomhī’ti paṭijānāmi.
mn49:30.11: desentopi hi pāpima tathāgato sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ tādisova. adesentopi hi pāpima tathāgato sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ tādisova.
mn49:30.12: upanentopi hi pāpima tathāgato sāvake tādisova. anupanentopi hi pāpima tathāgato sāvake tādisova.
mn49:30.14: tathāgatassa pāpima ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā,
mn49:30.15: te pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
mn49:30.16: seyyathāpi pāpima tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna virūḷhiyā,
mn49:30.17: evameva kho pāpima tathāgatassa ye āsavā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā,
mn49:30.18: te pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāti.
mn49:31.1: iti hidaṃ mārassa ca anālapanatāya brahmuno ca abhinimantanatāya tasmā imassa veyyākaraṇassa brahmanimantanikanteva adhivacananti.
